item.title: Open Source Java Testing & Assertion Libraries: AssertJ vs Hamcrest vs Google Truth
item.description: Choosing the right assertion library is one of the most impactful decisions a Java developer can make. While JUnit provides basic assertion methods, dedicated assertion libraries offer fluent, readable, and expressive APIs that dramatically improve test quality and developer experience for unit tests.
